name: Tiger
fact: No two tigers look the same, with unique stripe patterns like human fingerprints.

name: Lion
fact: Lions are social cats that live in prides.

name: Elephant
fact: Elephants have giant teeth, with a single tooth weighing up to 9 pounds.

name: Leopard
fact: Leopards are solitary big cats known for their stealth.

name: Cheetah
fact: The cheetah is the fastest land animal, capable of reaching speeds up to 75 mph.

name: Jaguar
fact: Jaguars have the strongest bite relative to size among big cats.

name: Giraffe
fact: Giraffes have the longest neck of any animal, helping them reach high vegetation.

name: Zebra
fact: Zebras have stripes that may help with camouflage, bug deterrence, or recognition.

name: Gorilla
fact: Gorillas are highly intelligent primates that live in social groups.

name: Chimpanzee
fact: Chimpanzees use tools and have complex social behaviors.

name: Bear
fact: Bears are omnivores with excellent sense of smell.

name: Kangaroo
fact: Marsupial that hops at high speeds.

name: Hippopotamus
fact: Hippos spend most of their time in water to stay cool.

name: Rhinoceros
fact: Rhinos have thick skin for protection against predators.

name: Wolf
fact: Wolves hunt in packs and communicate through howls.

name: Fox
fact: Foxes are cunning predators with a varied diet.

name: Moose
fact: Moose are the largest species in the deer family.

name: Sloth
fact: Sloths move very slowly and have algae-growing fur.

name: Hyena
fact: Hyenas are known for their strong jaws and scavenging.

name: Otter
fact: Otters hold hands while sleeping to avoid drifting apart.

name: Crocodile
fact: Crocodiles are ambush predators with powerful bites.

name: Komodo Dragon
fact: Komodo dragons are the largest lizards and hunt large prey.

name: Chameleon
fact: Chameleons change color for camouflage and communication.

name: Eagle
fact: Eagles have excellent eyesight for hunting.

name: Owl
fact: Owls have silent flight for stealthy hunting.

name: Penguin
fact: Penguins are flightless birds that swim excellently.

name: Shark
fact: Sharks have multiple rows of teeth.

name: Dolphin
fact: Dolphins are social mammals that use echolocation.

name: Whale
fact: The blue whale is the largest animal, weighing as much as three elephants.

name: Octopus
fact: Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood.

name: Panda
fact: Pandas are bears that eat almost exclusively bamboo.

name: Armadillo
fact: Armadillos have bony armor for protection.

name: Meerkat
fact: Meerkats live in groups with sentinels watching for danger.

name: Capybara
fact: Capybaras are the largest rodents and swim well.

name: Platypus
fact: Platypuses lay eggs and have electroreception.

name: Hedgehog
fact: Hedgehogs curl into balls for defense.

name: Koala
fact: Koalas sleep up to 20 hours a day on eucalyptus trees.

name: Porcupine
fact: Porcupines have quills for protection.

name: Beaver
fact: Beavers build dams with their teeth.

name: Lemur
fact: Blue-eyed lemurs have true blue eyes, rare among primates.

name: Fennec Fox
fact: Largest ears relative to body for heat radiation and prey tracking.

name: Flamingo
fact: Pink coloration impregnates tissues, skin, blood, and egg yolk.

name: Seahorse
fact: Males give birth after eggs develop in brood pouch.

name: Pufferfish
fact: Swell to twice size to evade predators.

name: Electric Eel
fact: Produce 600 volts shock.

name: Poison Dart Frog
fact: Toxins from diet.

name: Toucan
fact: Large colorful beak for feeding.

name: Snowy Owl
fact: White plumage for camouflage.

name: Harpy Eagle
fact: Largest eagle with powerful talons.

name: Great White Shark
fact: Teeth constantly replace in rows.
